subject: Key rotation forensic summary and custody commitments
messages:
From: Tim Halvorsen <tim@aurorafin.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: KPMG Audit Team <kpmg-ai-audit@kpmg.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: rotation artifacts + chain-of-custody for recent KEK rotation

Hi Grace,

As part of AuroraFin's quarterly SIG/SOC2 refresh, KPMG asked for a concise bundle describing the KEK rotation that ran last night (Aug 20-21 UTC window). Specifically they want: a rotation manifest with key IDs and epochs, operator shift logs showing who initiated the ceremony, the HSM firmware hash we validated during the operation, and a short narrative that ties these pieces together for auditors.

Can you provide an attested set (CSV + signed shift logs + hash) or point to where we can download them? KPMG has a narrow review window next week; having these files by EOD tomorrow Pacific would be ideal.

Also, please confirm if any tenant-level wrap keys were rewrapped or if this was limited to platform KEKs.

Thanks,
Tim
Security Engineer, AuroraFin

--
This request is time sensitive for their audit schedule.

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Tim Halvorsen <tim@aurorafin.com>
Cc: KPMG Audit Team <kpmg-ai-audit@kpmg.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Aug 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: rotation artifacts + chain-of-custody for recent KEK rotation

Tim — thanks for the note and clear list. We can provide the artifacts you listed. High level: the operation last night was a scheduled KEK rotation (platform KEK only) that did not rewrap customer tenant CSEKs. We will deliver:

- rotation-manifest-aurorafin.csv (ordered list: old_kek_id, new_kek_id, rotation_epoch, rotation_timestamp_utc, operator_id)
- operator-shiftlog-20290821.zip (redacted where appropriate; includes operator sign-in/out, ceremony triggers, and auditor marker events)
- hsm-firmware-hash-20290821.txt (SHA256 of HSM firmware image validated prior to activation)
- rotation-playbook-extract.pdf (2-page narrative mapping manifest -> shift logs -> HSM validation steps)

We will also add a short MD5/SHA256 checksum index and a signed manifest (PGP-signed by the on-call operator) for chain-of-custody.

I'm looping Jonas (runtime) and Marissa (compliance lead) to attach the artifacts and confirm contents. Expect a secure Drive link and the signed CSV within the hour. If KPMG needs an interactive replay (we can replay the ceremony timeline against immutable logs), we can schedule a 60-minute session and bring HSM Ops on the call.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will follow in separate email)

--
Grace: committing to EOD tomorrow Pacific delivery per their window.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Tim Halvorsen <tim@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Aug 2029 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: rotation artifacts + chain-of-custody for recent KEK rotation

Tim and team — attaching the artifacts here (see Drive link in Grace's follow). A few technical notes for the audit narrative: 

1) Scope: platform KEK rotation only. No tenant CSEK rewraps were triggered. We verify tenant isolation by the rewrap flag in the manifest (column: tenant_rewrap = false).

2) Rotation identifiers: each rotation_epoch maps to internal rotation run-id and a HSM ceremony-id. Those ids are included in rotation-manifest-aurorafin.csv; auditors can cross-check run-id -> HSM ceremony-id -> operator sign-off entries in the shift log.

3) KV cache impact: this rotation updated server-side KEK references only; there was an automated KV cache refresh across nodes (start and end timestamps included). We included the KV cache sync markers in operator-shiftlog-20290821.zip under kvsync/markers.tsv.

4) HSM validation: hsm-firmware-hash-20290821.txt contains the validated SHA256 and a timestamped attestation signed by the HSM vendor (ops@thsmvendor.com). The firmware validation was performed pre-activation and recorded in the HSM audit partition.

5) Forensics-friendly format: the CSV is normalized (RFC 4180) and we included an additional column for evidence pointers (S3 path or Drive file id) for every manifest line.

If KPMG wants, we can produce a compact artifact that contains the exact S3 object checksums and a short script to reproduce the hash chain; happy to walk them through it.

Jonas Weber
Principal Infrastructure Engineer — Runtime
Redwood Inference

Quoted for context:
On Wed, 21 Aug 2029 at 09:12 Tim Halvorsen <tim@aurorafin.com> wrote:
> As part of AuroraFin's quarterly SIG/SOC2 refresh, KPMG asked for a concise bundle...

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Tim Halvorsen <tim@aurorafin.com>, KPMG Audit Team <kpmg-ai-audit@kpmg.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, HSM Ops <ops@thsmvendor.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Aug 2029 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: rotation artifacts and proposed replay session

Tim / KPMG — attached are the artifacts and a short narrative. Links & checksums are below. If anything looks incomplete, flag it and we will expand the packet.

Drive folder (secure, auditor-access): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-aurorafin-rotation-evidence
Files provided:
- rotation-manifest-aurorafin.csv (PGP-signed: manifest.sig)
- operator-shiftlog-20290821.zip (includes kvsync/markers.tsv, operator sign-in/out CSV, ceremony transcripts)
- hsm-firmware-hash-20290821.txt (SHA256: f3a1b2... ; vendor-signed attestation included)
- rotation-playbook-extract.pdf (2 pages mapping artifacts for audit)

Checksums index (SHA256): see MD5-SHA256-index.txt in the folder.

We propose a 60-minute replay session on Thu 22 Aug 2029 10:00-11:00 PT to walk KPMG through the manifest and show how IDs map to immutable logs. Ben from Sales will join to coordinate any procurement/AO access confirmations. HSM Ops is cc'd to support firmware validation questions.

Please reply with: (1) confirmed attendees/time, (2) whether you need the compact reproducible script (we can include it as a signed artifact), and (3) whether you need tenant-level rewrap evidence (not applicable for this rotation; we can supply historical rewrap records if required).

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rotation-manifest-aurorafin.csv (signed), operator-shiftlog-20290821.zip, hsm-firmware-hash-20290821.txt, rotation-playbook-extract.pdf

--
Internal note: we retained a copy in the secure evidence bucket and created SUP-8421 to track the replay scheduling and audit follow-ups.
